message.content: Starting the hunt with broad random sweeps to map the space.
Found a wall penetration — shrinking it to isolate the failure.
Shrunk to a minimal case. Verifying it reproduces and gathering evidence.
Replay confirms the failure. Inspecting the violation moment and prior steps.
Body 1 is moving fast at the violation. Checking earlier states to trace its path.
Tracking the trajectory backward to locate the collision.
I see a high-speed near-corner encounter; rendering frames to confirm the picture before the causal test.
Frames confirm a fast body clipping the wall corner. Testing a causal fix with reduced bounce.
